archetypes.name: dyn-bg-wait
archetypes.rationale: Step 3 marker cleanup and timeout semantics are central to the change.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3 bg-wait marker flow in dispatch_commit_route.py. Focus on whether stale terminal and probe-denial sidecars are cleared before marker arming, and whether non-Step 3 sites remain unchanged. Check that the 15600-second composite timeout stays intentional and documented. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
